title: Moved to Sales Ops, wants Finance "for handover"

sources: P1 AC-02 h.2 [14 days], AC-02(07), Appendix B (6) (revision P: 30 days, previous supervisor)
source.what_we_took: See SOURCES.md and V4_DESIGN.md. People, IDs and details are invented.

tricky: Transfer effective today. sales-ops-crm (standard) needs the new manager's approval. fin-ledger-close is restricted to Finance: POL-100 5.5 allows keeping it for a hand-over for no longer than PG-01-07's period after a transfer ([14 days], AC-02 h.2 and PS-05), with the OWNER's retained_access approval, expiry set. The stale Appendix B says 30 days with the previous supervisor's agreement. Removing it is also policy-compliant (keeping is a 'may'); both are accepted.
resolution_summary: sales-ops-crm added; fin-ledger-close either kept until 2026-11-11 with the owner's retained_access approval, or removed; ticket resolved.

can_see: your own phone (texts, calls, sign-in prompts, your authenticator app) unless your facts say you don't have it
your own laptop and what it lets you do
your work email and your personal email
messages from your manager and colleagues
cant_see: IT's systems: the directory, the approval system, device management
the company's IT policy wiki and its rules
reveal_rules: Ask for 30 days at first. If the agent says that's longer than allowed, say fine, whatever's allowed.
user.persona: Noor Rahimi, who moved from the general ledger team to Sales Operations today. Organised and polite.
user.situation: Your transfer to Sales Operations took effect today. You need the sales-ops-crm group for your new job, and you'd like to keep fin-ledger-close for a while to hand over the month-end journals.
user.goal: Get sales-ops-crm, and keep fin-ledger-close long enough to hand over.
facts: Your name is Noor Rahimi, employee ID E7101.
Your new manager is Pablo Ibarra; your previous manager is Wendy Cho.
You'd like 30 days for the hand-over, but a couple of weeks would do.
user.opening: hi, I moved to sales ops today. could I get sales-ops-crm, and keep fin-ledger-close for 30 days for handover?
user.end_condition: you know what you have now and until when, and you've said thanks.
